title: Offline per-bar in-trade path emit from the backtest harnesses (--emit-paths): the data the in-trade exit model learns from
note: [2026-10-14 lane IN-TRADE-EXIT-MODEL] THE BINDING GAP for the exit line's destination (operator 2026-10-14: real-time P(SL before TP | trade state now) and an exit-now mechanism; row IN-TRADE-EXIT-MODEL). Today: harness --emit-trades rows are per-TRADE (mfe_r only, a lagged lower bound), live position_telemetry is one upserted row per position, MAE is recorded nowhere. BUILD: every harness that writes --emit-trades gains --emit-paths <file>: one JSONL row per (trade, bar) from the bar after entry to the exit bar, carrying bar ts, open/high/low/close in R from entry, the stop and target IN FORCE at that bar in R (so trailing, TP revision, stale/giveback exits are captured as the leg actually trades), open_r, running peak_r and mae_r, bars_since_peak, ATR and ADX at the bar; plus mae_r on every trade row. Order: scripts/backtest_trend.py + scripts/backtest_pullback.py first (the real-money families: trend_donchian_*_4h, *_pullback_2h), then backtest_ict_scalp.py / backtest_squeeze.py. Must reuse the harness's own bar loop (no re-walk), off by default (no change to any existing emit byte-for-byte), and carry a parity test: per trade, max(peak_r over the path rows) == the trade row's mfe_r. TIER-1 (offline research tooling; no order path, no config). PRIORITY: it does not wait for live data. INTERIM: scripts/research/first_passage.py re-walks committed ledgers over public candles with a FIXED bracket (initial SL, fixed K R) -- enough for the census/baseline/policy units RQ-20261014-d6e7-01..05, NOT for the leg as traded. CONSUMERS: RQ-20261014-d6e7-06 (harness-native first-passage census, blocked on this row), blocked/RQ-20261014-9807-05 (momentum-turn label study: per-bar ADX/ATR/open_r), RQ-20261011-9da8-04 (exit-arm bandit OPE: per-bar states under each ladder arm), Programme 02 Q3.3. DONE WHEN: a config-exact run of the 4 bybit_2 4h/2h legs emits path rows whose per-trade max(peak_r) equals the trade's mfe_r on >= 99% of trades, committed under comms/strategy_evidence/runs/, and d6e7-06 leaves blocked/.
